description: Small DE->EN smoke set used by the converter tests. Mixed domains: greetings, conversational, weather, technical, business, travel, food. Reference translations are produced by Helsinki-NLP/opus-mt-de-en itself with greedy decoding -- i.e. they are 'self-consistency' references, not gold human translations. Strict parity vs transformers is judged in #6.
